# JOITA Bioseed AI

Last updated: 2026-08-06

JOITA Bioseed AI is a farmer-first agri-AI startup combining AI-guided recommendations, biological crop inputs, field validation, and edge sensing for climate-resilient agriculture.

## Product Portfolio

- BioSynth Prime: waste-to-wealth soil-water resilience concept using FA-WAP hydrogel matrix, rice stubble, fly ash, and Bacillus subtilis under field validation.
- BioSynth Nano: biological crop input platform designed to support crop resilience and smarter input timing.
- FarmAssist AI: public AI-powered agricultural assistant with offline-first crop advisory support, live AI when configured, weather context, disease advisory, soil recommendations, market prices, and field records.
- SmartSeedMat: seed and nursery support material for early establishment and smallholder use.
- AquaSynth Nano: aquaculture support concept for water-quality pilots and validation.
- AgriTrust TriLeaf Edge Node: design-protected agricultural IoT sensing and edge-computing device for localized root-zone field intelligence and FarmAssist data loops.

## Safety And Claims

JOITA uses advisory, validation-focused wording and avoids absolute performance promises. Product and AI recommendations are for support only. Farmers should confirm pesticide or fertilizer decisions with local labels, KVK, agriculture experts, and applicable regulations.
